تفتتحوا (form VIII)
# تَفْتَتِحُوا (taftatiḥū) /taf.ta.ti.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# تُفْتَتَحُوا (tuftataḥū) /tuf.ta.ta.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
